consumer_contract.J: RTL reads IEEE binary32 identity bits; CONVERT_IDENTITY executes signed32 saturate(RNE(identity*2^20)) in one paid vector cycle
consumer_contract.wide: signed64 p*a + (b+J)*2^20; performed MUL, ADD_BIAS, ADD_IDENTITY in separate states
consumer_contract.I24: signed24 saturate(RNE(wide / 2^26)); negative ties use floor quotient and positive remainder
consumer_contract.same_function: All D3 modes exactly the same frozen deployment function; no z or p RNE and no change to real IEEE32 identity conversion.

consumer_common_resources.rounding: 8 signed64-to-signed24 RNE/saturation units, including rounding increment/comparison logic
consumer_common_resources.coefficient_memory: 8 x 24 x signed32 = 768 bytes; ONE 256-bit common-row read, separate a then b reads; 24 vector reads per tile
consumer_common_resources.buffers: p/J/a/b each 8x32 bits, one 8x64 accumulator, one 8x32 output = 224 bytes; no full identity/output array in consumer
consumer_common_resources.coefficient_reuse: a/b hold reused across all 40 P/T rows in each N8 group; same reuse for every producer mode
consumer_common_resources.raw_interface: 8x32 ready/valid, single-entry; address checked against expected row
consumer_common_resources.identity_interface: Independent 8x32 IEEE binary32 raw-bit ready/valid, single-entry; actual tile+row address request, stalls paid. Finite input domain; exponent/significand shift, guard/remainder parity, saturation. NaN/Inf set error.
consumer_common_resources.output: 8 signed24 I24 sign-extended in a 256-bit transport vector; tile, row, tile_last and job_last
consumer_common_resources.diagnostics: 15 x 32-bit consumer counters; diagnostic raw/J outputs are observation-only and do not supply execution values
consumer_common_resources.not_free_widening: These eight wider multipliers and adders are ADDED shared backend resources, not the old 16x13 multipliers relabeled as 32x32
consumer_common_resources.conversion_storage: The same 8x32 identity register first holds FP32 bits then J20, no duplicate vector storage; conversion monitor is combinational diagnostic only

scope: two contexts, single shared producer arithmetic/weight array, complete native frame plus real FP32-to-I24 consumer

modes.0: sequential compute, next context may compute while first drains
modes.1: phase-offset: context1 starts when context0 Q1 complete
modes.2: ordinary both-ready round-robin; both start after two source tiles loaded

shared_producer.grant_rule: disjoint resources can proceed together; overlap RR. ZADD/MAC require atomic z+ALU

private_common.other_state: both context declarations in thread_context.sv, including metadata, holds, accumulators, pointers and counters
